issues.message: FR-APP-003 (renewal prefilled from previous year) conflicts with FR-DOC-003 (reuse of verified documents for renewal). FR-APP-003 requires prefilling previous year's data, but FR-DOC-003 states documents are reused and not re-uploaded unless expired. However, FR-APP-003 does not specify how to handle cases where a certificate has expired or is missing, creating a gap between the two requirements.
issues.suggestion: Clarify in FR-APP-003 that if any required document (caste, income, or attendance) is expired or missing, the system must prompt the applicant to upload it, while retaining other verified documents. Add an explicit exception flow for expired documents.

issues.message: FR-APP-006 (one re-application after rejection) conflicts with FR-VER-002 (return for correction). FR-APP-006 allows one corrected re-application, but FR-VER-002 allows the institution nodal officer to return for correction within 15 days, implying the applicant can correct and resubmit. However, FR-APP-006 does not specify whether the 'one chance to correct' from VB-3 applies to both institution and district levels or only to the final rejection. This creates ambiguity in the correction workflow.
issues.suggestion: Specify in FR-APP-006 that the one re-application applies to the final rejection by the District Social Welfare Officer, and that institution-level returns for correction (FR-VER-002) are separate and do not count toward the one re-application limit. Alternatively, merge the logic so that VB-3's one chance applies uniformly at the district level.

issues.message: FR-ESC-001 and FR-ESC-002 (escalation) reference 'daily escalation job runs' but do not specify the exact time, frequency, or mechanism (e.g., cron job, batch process). This makes it difficult to test the timing and reliability of escalations.
issues.suggestion: Add a requirement specifying the exact time (e.g., 09:00 IST daily) and the technical mechanism (e.g., scheduled batch job) for the escalation process, along with the expected response time for the escalation notification.

issues.message: FR-NOT-009 (SMS on payment failure) references ANS-1 (notify student to correct bank details within 30 days; re-initiate in next weekly batch) but does not specify what happens if the student fails to update bank details within 30 days. There is no exception flow for non-response.
issues.suggestion: Add an exception flow: if the student does not update bank details within 30 days, the application status should be marked as 'Payment failed - no response' and the applicant should be informed by SMS that the application is closed. The application may be re-opened only if the student contacts the district office.

issues.message: FR-VER-003 (Sanction) requires business rules BR-001 to BR-004 to be satisfied before sanctioning, but does not specify what happens if a business rule fails during the sanction attempt. The system blocks the action (as per AC), but there is no exception flow for the officer to understand the failure or for the applicant to be informed.
issues.suggestion: Add an exception flow: if any business rule fails, the system should display the failed rule ID to the officer, and the applicant should receive an SMS (or email) indicating the reason for rejection and the opportunity to correct and re-apply, in line with VB-3.

issues.message: FR-APP-004 (student mobile application) states the application appears on the portal with the same number and status, but does not specify what happens if the mobile app is offline or the student submits while offline. There is no exception flow for offline submission or synchronization.
issues.suggestion: Add an exception flow: if the mobile app is offline, the application should be saved locally and synchronized when connectivity is restored, with a notification to the applicant that the application is pending synchronization.

issues.message: FR-APP-002 (assisted application at CSC) requires the applicant to enter OTP within 10 minutes, but does not specify what happens if the OTP is not entered within 10 minutes. The AC already states it is refused, but there is no exception flow for the applicant to request a new OTP or retry.
issues.suggestion: Add an exception flow: if the OTP is not entered within 10 minutes, the system should allow the applicant to request a new OTP up to three times within a 24-hour period.

blocks.SOURCES:
[GO-1] (Info) The State Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme is presently administered through paper applications submitted at institutions and forwarded to District Social Welfare Offices. Applications take 6 to 9 months to be sanctioned, files are lost in transit, and students have no means of knowing the status of their application.
[GO-2] (Info) Government has decided that all applications under the scheme, fresh and renewal, shall be received, verified, sanctioned and paid online from the academic year 2026-27, so that eligible students receive the scholarship in a transparent and time-bound manner.
[GO-3.1] (Rule) The applicant shall be a domicile of Rajyapradesh.
[GO-3.3] (Rule) The applicant shall be studying in a post-matric course in an institution recognised by the competent authority in Rajyapradesh.
[GO-3.4] (Rule) For renewal, the applicant shall have attended at least 75% of classes in the previous academic year, as certified by the institution.
[GO-4.1] (Mandate) Applications shall be submitted online through the scholarship portal or through Common Service Centres (CSCs).
[GO-4.2] (Mandate) Aadhaar-based e-KYC of the applicant shall be mandatory.
[GO-4.3] (Mandate) Caste and income certificates shall be obtained from DigiLocker where available; otherwise the applicant shall upload the certificate in the prescribed format in Annexure A.
[GO-5.1] (Timeline) The nodal officer of the institution shall verify the application within 15 days of submission.
[GO-5.2] (Timeline) The District Social Welfare Officer shall sanction or reject the verified application within 15 days of receipt.
[GO-5.3] (Mandate) Reasons shall be recorded in writing for every rejection and communicated to the applicant.
[GO-6.1] (Mandate) The scholarship shall be paid through Direct Benefit Transfer using PFMS to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the applicant.
[GO-6.2] (Timeline) The scholarship shall be paid in a single instalment not later than 31 March of the academic year.
[GO-7.1] (Mandate) An online grievance facility shall be provided to applicants.
[GO-7.2] (Mandate) The applicant shall be informed by SMS at every stage of processing of the application.
[GO-7.3] (Timeline) Grievances shall be resolved within 7 working days of receipt.
[GO-8.1] (Mandate) A dashboard shall be provided to the District Social Welfare Officer showing district-wise status of applications.
[GO-8.2] (Mandate) A monthly report shall be submitted to the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare Department.
[GO-9] (Timeline) The scholarship shall be sanctioned within 30 working days of submission of a complete application, and the service is notified under the Rajyapradesh Right to Service Act.
[GO-10] (Mandate) Personal data collected under the scheme shall be used only for the purposes of the scheme.
[COR1-1] (Rule) In paragraph 3.2 of the G.O. read above, for "Rs. 2,50,000 (Rupees two lakh fifty thousand only)" read "Rs. 3,00,000 (Rupees three lakh only)". The annual family income limit for eligibility is accordingly Rs. 3,00,000 per annum.
[COR1-2] (Info) All other conditions of the G.O. remain unchanged.
[MIN-1] (Mandate) CSC operators shall be permitted to apply on behalf of students who do not have internet access, and the acknowledgement shall be sent to the student's mobile number.
[MIN-2] (Mandate) For renewal applications, documents already verified in the previous year shall be reused and shall not be uploaded again.
[MIN-3] (Mandate) The portal shall be available in Hindi and English.
[MIN-5] (Mandate) The portal shall work on low-end Android phones on 3G connections.
[VB-1] (Mandate) There should also be a mobile application for students, because most students have only a mobile phone.
[VB-2] (Mandate) The District Social Welfare Officer needs a dashboard showing the pending applications of every institution and how long they have been pending.
[VB-3] (Mandate) If an application is rejected, the student should be told the reason for rejection by SMS and be given one chance to correct it and apply again.
[FORM-1] (Info) Name of the applicant (as in Aadhaar)
[FORM-2] (Info) Father's / Guardian's name
[FORM-3] (Info) Date of birth (DD/MM/YYYY)
[FORM-4] (Info) Gender (Male / Female / Transgender)
[FORM-5] (Info) Category (SC / ST / OBC / EWS)
[FORM-6] (Info) Aadhaar number
[FORM-7] (Info) Mobile number
[FORM-8] (Info) Permanent address
[FORM-9] (Info) District
[FORM-10] (Info) PIN code
[FORM-11] (Info) Name of the institution
[FORM-12] (Info) Course
[FORM-13] (Info) Year of study
[FORM-14] (Info) Annual family income (Rs.)
[FORM-15] (Info) Bank account number
[FORM-16] (Info) IFSC code
[FORM-17] (Info) Attendance in previous year (%) (for renewal only)
[FORM-18] (Info) Caste certificate number
[FORM-19] (Info) Income certificate number
[FORM-20] (Info) Declaration: I declare that the information given above is true. Signature of applicant and date.
blocks.SUPERSEDED:
[GO-3.2] superseded by COR1-1: The annual income of the applicant's family from all sources shall not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 (Rupees two lakh fifty thousand only).
[MIN-4] superseded by GO-5.1: Institution verification shall be completed within 10 days of submission.
blocks.RESOLUTIONS:
[RES-1] Supersession GO-3.2, COR1-1: COR1-1 prevails.
[RES-2] Conflict GO-5.1, MIN-4: GO-5.1 prevails.
[RES-3] MissingReference GO-4.3: deferred to the department (open issue).
blocks.ANSWERS:
[ANS-1] When a DBT payment fails in PFMS (for example the account is not Aadhaar-seeded or is closed), what should happen to the application? Answer: Notify the student by SMS to correct bank details within 30 days; re-initiate in the next weekly batch
[ANS-2] Can a student appeal against rejection by the District Social Welfare Officer, and to whom? Answer: Appeal to the Director, Social Welfare within 30 days
blocks.ASSUMPTIONS:
[ASM-3] Legacy data migration: Only 2025-26 beneficiaries are migrated as a beneficiary master for renewal; pending paper applications are not migrated.
[ASM-4] Escalation on SLA breach: Institution delays are escalated to the District Social Welfare Officer, and DSWO delays to the Joint Director, Social Welfare.
[ASM-5] Renewal: The renewal window opens on 1 July and last year's beneficiaries receive a prefilled renewal application.
[ASM-6] Data retention: Applicant data is retained for 8 years after the last payment and then anonymised.
[ASM-7] Audit: All status changes, data edits and exports are logged, and the audit trail is viewable by the State administrator.

queried, then they are available.","Given a simulated incident, when the incident procedure is run, then a report is prepared for CERT-In within 6 hours."],"refs":["STD-CERTIN"]},{"id":"NFR-010","title":"Security audit before go-live","text":"The system shall obtain a safe-to-host certificate from a CERT-In empanelled auditor after closure of all high and medium findings before go-live and after every major release.","ac":["Given the go-live date, when the release checklist is reviewed, then a valid safe-to-host certificate is on record."],"refs":["STD-SECAUDIT"]},{"id":"NFR-011","title":"Hosting in India","text":"The system shall be hosted in the Rajyapradesh State Data Centre or a MeitY empanelled cloud, with all data and backups stored within India.","ac":["Given the deployment architecture, when reviewed, then all compute, storage and backup locations are within India."],"refs":["STD-HOST"]},{"id":"NFR-012","title":"Right to Service timeline tracking","text":"The system shall compute, for every application, the working days elapsed against the notified Right to Service timeline of 30 working days, excluding days pending with the applicant, and display it to officers and the applicant.","ac":["Given an application submitted on a working day, when 20 working days have elapsed, then the officer dashboard shows 20 of the notified days consumed."],"refs":["STD-RTS","GO-9"]},{"id":"NFR-013","title":"DBT reconciliation","text":"The system shall reconcile every PFMS payment status daily and show paid, failed and pending counts per district.","ac":["Given PFMS status files for a day, when reconciliation runs, then every payment record has a status matching PFMS."],"refs":["STD-PFMS"]},{"id":"FR-REG-001","title":"Applicant registration with mobile OTP","text":"The system shall register an applicant with a mobile number verified by a 6-digit OTP valid for 10 minutes, and allow one active registration per mobile number.","ac":["Given a new mobile number, when the correct OTP is entered within 10 minutes, then the applicant account is created.","Given a mobile number already registered, when registration is attempted, then the system refuses it and offers sign-in."],"refs":["GO-4.1"]},{"id":"FR-REG-002","title":"Aadhaar e-KYC of the applicant","text":"The system shall perform Aadhaar OTP e-KYC of every applicant through the State AUA/KUA before an application can be submitted, prefill name, date of birth and gender from the e-KYC response as read-only fields, and store the Aadhaar number only in the Aadhaar Data Vault.","ac":["Given consent is recorded and a valid Aadhaar number is entered, when the e-KYC OTP is verified, then name, date of birth and gender are prefilled and cannot be edited.","Given e-KYC fails three times, when the applicant retries, then the system directs the applicant to a CSC for biometric e-KYC."],"refs":["GO-4.2","STD-AADHAAR"]},{"id":"FR-REG-003","title":"Officer sign-in with jurisdiction","text":"The system shall authenticate institution nodal officers and District Social Welfare Officers through Jan Parichay with two-factor authentication and show each officer only the applications of their institution or district.","ac":["Given a nodal officer mapped to one institution, when they sign in, then only applications of that institution are listed."],"refs":["GO-5.1","GO-5.2"]},{"id":"FR-APP-001","title":"Fresh application","text":"The system shall allow a registered applicant to fill a fresh application with personal, institution, course, income and bank details, save it as a draft at every step, and submit it only after accepting the declaration.","ac":["Given all mandatory fields are completed and the declaration is accepted, when the applicant submits, then an application number in the format PMS/<district code>/<year>/<serial> is generated and shown."],"refs":["GO-4.1","GO-2"]},{"id":"FR-APP-002","title":"Assisted application with applicant consent at CSC","text":"The system shall allow a CSC operator to submit an application on behalf of an applicant after recording the applicant's consent by OTP to the applicant's mobile number, and shall record the CSC ID on the application.","ac":["Given a CSC operator signed in through CSC Digital Seva, when the applicant enters the OTP sent to their mobile number, then the application is submitted with the CSC ID recorded and the acknowledgement is sent to the applicant's mobile number.","Given the OTP is not entered within 10 minutes, when submission is attempted, then it is refused."],"refs":["GO-4.1","MIN-1"]},{"id":"FR-APP-003","title":"Renewal application","text":"The system shall allow a student sanctioned in the previous academic year to submit a renewal application prefilled from the previous year's application, requiring only the previous year's attendance and any changed details.","ac":["Given a student sanctioned in 2026-27, when the renewal window opens, then a prefilled renewal application is available with the previous year's data."],"refs":["GO-3.4","MIN-2","ASM-5"]},{"id":"FR-APP-004","title":"Student mobile application","text":"The system shall provide an Android mobile application for students with registration, application, document upload, status tracking and grievance functions equivalent to the portal.","ac":["Given the mobile application, when a student completes an application on it, then the application appears on the portal with the same number and status."],"refs":["VB-1","GO-4.1"]},{"id":"FR-APP-005","title":"Application status tracking","text":"The system shall show the applicant the current status, the office with which the application is pending, and the working days elapsed against the 30 working day service timeline.","ac":["Given an application pending with the institution for 6 working days, when the applicant views status, then it shows \"Pending institution verification, 6 of 30 working days\"."],"refs":["GO-9","GO-7.2"]},{"id":"FR-APP-006","title":"One re-application after rejection","text":"The system shall allow an applicant whose application is rejected to submit one corrected re-application in the same academic year, reusing documents not cited in the rejection reason.","ac":["Given a rejected application, when the applicant re-applies, then documents not cited in the rejection are carried over.","Given a student has already re-applied once in the academic year, when a second re-application is attempted, then it is refused."],"refs":["VB-3","WF-T8"]},{"id":"FR-DOC-001","title":"Certificates from DigiLocker","text":"The system shall fetch the applicant's caste and income certificates from DigiLocker with the applicant's consent and attach them to the application as verified at source.","ac":["Given the applicant grants DigiLocker consent and an income certificate exists, when fetched, then it is attached with issuer and date and marked verified at source."],"refs":["GO-4.3"]},{"id":"FR-DOC-002","title":"Upload where not in DigiLocker","text":"The system shall allow the applicant to upload a caste or income certificate as a PDF or JPEG of up to 2 MB only when it is not available in DigiLocker, in the format to be notified by the department (open issue RES-3).","ac":["Given a certificate not found in DigiLocker, when the applicant proceeds, then upload of a PDF or JPEG of up to 2 MB is enabled.","Given a file of 3 MB, when uploaded, then it is refused with the size limit stated."],"refs":["GO-4.3","RES-3"]},{"id":"FR-DOC-003","title":"Reuse of verified documents for renewal","text":"The system shall reuse documents verified in the previous academic year for a renewal application and shall not ask the applicant to upload them again, unless the certificate has expired.","ac":["Given a renewal application with a caste certificate verified last year, when the application is opened, then the certificate is attached and no upload is requested."],"refs":["MIN-2"]},{"id":"FR-VER-007","title":"Verification checklist for the nodal officer","text":"The system shall show the institution nodal officer each application with its documents, DigiLocker verification status and the results of business rules BR-001 to BR-004, and require each checklist item to be marked before the application can be verified.","ac":["Given an application with one checklist item unmarked, when the nodal officer tries to verify it, then the system blocks the action and highlights the item."],"refs":["GO-5.1","BR-003"]},{"id":"FR-VER-008","title":"Bulk sanction by the District Social Welfare Officer","text":"The system shall allow the District Social Welfare Officer to sanction up to 100 verified applications together after reviewing the list, recording each sanction individually in the audit trail.","ac":["Given 40 verified applications selected, when the DSWO sanctions them together, then 40 individual sanction entries appear in the audit trail."],"refs":["GO-5.2"]},{"id":"FR-PAY-001","title":"DBT payment batch to PFMS","text":"The system shall generate a PFMS DBT payment batch every week for sanctioned applications, crediting the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of each applicant, push it to PFMS and record the PFMS acknowledgement against each application.","ac":["Given 250 sanctioned applications in a week, when the weekly batch runs, then one batch with 250 payment records is pushed and each application shows the PFMS acknowledgement number."],"refs":["GO-6.1","STD-PFMS"]},{"id":"FR-PAY-002","title":"Single instalment by 31 March","text":"The system shall pay the full scholarship amount in a single instalment and list to the District Social Welfare Officer, from 1 March, sanctioned applications not yet paid for that academic year.","ac":["Given a sanctioned application unpaid on 1 March, when the DSWO opens the payment list, then the application appears with the days remaining to 31 March."],"refs":["GO-6.2"]},{"id":"FR-PAY-003","title":"Payment credit confirmation","text":"The system shall update an application to Paid on receipt of the PFMS credit confirmation and show the UTR number and credit date to the applicant.","ac":["Given PFMS confirms credit, when the status file is processed, then the application shows Paid with the UTR number."],"refs":["GO-6.1","WF-T13"]},{"id":"FR-NOT-010","title":"SMS language and delivery status","text":"The system shall send every SMS in the applicant's chosen language, Hindi or English, using DLT-registered templates, and record the delivery status of each message.","ac":["Given an applicant who chose Hindi, when any SMS is triggered, then the Hindi template is used and the delivery report is stored."],"refs":["GO-7.2","MIN-3"]},{"id":"FR-GRV-001","title":"Online grievance registration","text":"The system shall allow an applicant to register a grievance online against an application, with category and description, and shall route it quickly to the District Social Welfare Officer of the applicant's district.","ac":["Given a grievance registered against an application, when it is saved, then a grievance number is shown and it appears in the DSWO's grievance list."],"refs":["GO-7.1"]},{"id":"FR-GRV-002","title":"Grievance disposal","text":"The system shall allow the District Social Welfare Officer to record the action taken and close a grievance, and send an SMS to the applicant with the action taken.","ac":["Given an action taken report of at least 50 characters, when the DSWO closes the grievance, then the applicant receives an SMS with the action taken."],"refs":["GO-7.1","GO-7.2"]},{"id":"FR-GRV-003","title":"Appeal against rejection","text":"The system shall allow an applicant to file an appeal to the Director, Social Welfare within 30 days of rejection, and the Director shall decide it within 15 working days.","ac":["Given a rejection on 1 October, when the applicant files an appeal on 25 October, then the appeal is registered and assigned to the Director.","Given 31 days since rejection, when an appeal is attempted, then it is refused."],"refs":["ANS-2","WF-T9"]},{"id":"FR-RPT-001","title":"District dashboard of pending applications","text":"The system shall show the District Social Welfare Officer a dashboard of applications by status for the district, with pending applications of each institution and the working days each has been pending, refreshed every 15 minutes.","ac":["Given 12 applications pending with an institution, when the DSWO opens the dashboard, then the institution row shows 12 with the oldest pending days."],"refs":["GO-8.1","VB-2"]},{"id":"FR-RPT-002","title":"Monthly report to the Principal Secretary","text":"The system shall generate on the 1st of every month a report for the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare, with district-wise applications received, sanctioned, rejected, paid and pending, as PDF and Excel.","ac":["Given month end, when the report is generated, then district totals match the application data as of the last day of the month."],"refs":["GO-8.2"]},{"id":"FR-RPT-003","title":"Right to Service compliance report","text":"The system shall report, for each district, applications that exceeded the 30 working day service timeline, with the stage at which the delay occurred.","ac":["Given an application sanctioned on working day 34, when the report runs, then it is listed with the stage that exceeded its SLA."],"refs":["GO-9"]},{"id":"FR-RPT-004","title":"Payment reconciliation report","text":"The system shall report sanctioned, paid, failed and pending payments by district and PFMS batch.","ac":["Given a PFMS batch, when the report is opened, then paid, failed and pending counts add up to the batch size."],"refs":["GO-6.1"]},{"id":"FR-ADM-001","title":"Institution, course and district masters","text":"The system shall allow the State administrator to maintain institution, course and district masters, with LGD codes for districts and a recognition flag for institutions.","ac":["Given an institution marked not recognised, when an applicant selects it, then the course eligibility rule BR-003 fails."],"refs":["GO-3.3","STD-EGOV"]},{"id":"FR-ADM-002","title":"User and role management","text":"The system shall allow the State administrator to create officer accounts and map each nodal officer to one institution and each District Social Welfare Officer to one district.","ac":["Given a nodal officer transferred, when their mapping is changed, then pending applications move to the new nodal officer of the institution."],"refs":["GO-5.1","GO-5.2"]},{"id":"FR-ADM-003","title":"Import of 2025-26 beneficiaries","text":"The system shall import the list of 2025-26 beneficiaries as a master for renewal, with name, institution, course and bank details, and report records that fail validation.","ac":["Given an import file of 10,000 records, when imported, then accepted and rejected counts add up to 10,000 and rejected records are downloadable with reasons."],"refs":["ASM-3"]},{"id":"FR-ADM-004","title":"Scheme parameters","text":"The system shall allow the State administrator to configure the income limit, attendance threshold and stage timelines as parameters with effective dates, without code changes.","ac":["Given a new income limit effective from a date, when an application submitted after that date is checked, then the new limit is applied."],"refs":["COR1-1","GO-3.4","GO-9"]},{"id":"NFR-014","title":"Low-end Android phones on 3G","text":"The mobile application and the portal shall work on Android 8 or later with 2 GB RAM, and each applicant screen shall load within 5 seconds on a 3G connection of 1 Mbps.","ac":["Given a device with Android 8 and 2 GB RAM on a throttled 1 Mbps connection, when each applicant screen is opened, then it is usable within 5 seconds."],"refs":["MIN-5"]},{"id":"NFR-015","title":"Retention of applicant data","text":"The system shall retain applicant data for 8 years after the last payment and then anonymise personal data fields, logging each anonymisation run.","ac":["Given records 8 years past the last payment, when the retention job runs, then personal data fields are anonymised and the run is logged."],"refs":["ASM-6","GO-10"]}]
